definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.150) 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division'; §2023:3.145 adds 'paragraph, section' explicitly, which a single paragraph or section already is in 2002, so the set of procedures is the same. This rule's use ('output procedure') names the same units in 2002; scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination); 2002 14.5.3 says 'paragraph' where 2023 says 'procedure', 2002 14.5.10 has the MCS purge item and lacks COMMIT and dynamic-table items, 2002 initial state also initializes the communication section. The rule rests on §2002:14.5.3 items 1 and 2 (implicit transfer to the output procedure and back from its last statement). For an output procedure the last statement of its last paragraph is the end of its range in both wordings, so the return point is the same; 14.5.2.1.2.1 and 14.5.10 are not relied on. Shown at 2002 by the reader's pb1141/pb3511 witnesses.
